name: Coding Models
blurb: Models trained for code generation, review, and repair. Membership is the Hub's own code tag on text-generation models, ranked by all-time downloads.

items.claim: Zhipu's open weight GLM-4.6 coding model, released in September 2025, lists 357 billion parameters and a 200,000 token context window.
Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 4.5 together with Claude Code 2.0, a native VS Code extension and checkpoints.
GitHub reported Copilot wrote 46 percent of the code in files where it was enabled.
